messages:
Maya Patel: Creating a follow-up PR to tighten up the AuroraX-13b model card after yesterday's merge. Main items: clarify variant sequence caps, add a short SDK v1->v3 migration checklist, and fix two broken links in the benchmarks section. I'll open PR in a few minutes.

Connor Lee: thanks Maya. Could you include exact variant caps so I can update the matrix? I want to avoid any accidental mismatch between model card and the catalog table.

Maya Patel: sure. main model: max_context=12288, recommended_batch=4 on p4d; small variant: max_context=6144, recommended_batch=2. Note: small variant uses fused attention kernels which reduce memory but also slightly lower throughput (~10%).

Rina Shah: on the migration checklist, please call out the snippet diff for streaming in v3. many customers use the old blocking chat.create pattern. Example diff would help.

Tom Becker: I can assist with the link fixes. Found two dead anchors in the benchmark section: the 'methodology' anchor changed in a prior PR. I'll add permanent links to the static assets.

Maya Patel: thanks Tom. Also adding a short compatibility note: older quant profiles that relied on CPU f16 fallback must be reprofiled to cpu_int8 or pin to dedicated nodes. I'll include a template quant-profile snippet and rollback steps.

Connor Lee: for the catalog sync, after your PR merges I can run the import script that pulls model card limits into the catalog. One request: add a machine-readable limits table (YAML block) at the top of the card so the script can parse reliably.

Maya Patel: good idea. I'll add a YAML fenced block labeled "limits: yaml" with the keys: max_context, recommended_batch, variants.

Rina Shah: snippet for v3 streaming (I'll paste):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
with client.chat.stream(model="aurorax-13b") as s:
    s.send({"role":"user","content":"Explain KV caching"})
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text, end='')
```

Tom Becker: PR preview looks good locally. CI flagged two long lines and an alt-text missing on a PNG. I'll patch them in a followup commit.
